title: KKT‑guided strict finalize v1 + 120s tail (1080s+120s; eps=5e−8)
abstract: Deterministic KKT‑guided strict‑finalize for 1080s (30s segments, dK=12) with strict projector (pair/boundary eps=5e−8), followed by a 120s micro‑tail. Dual+slack frontier ordering; exact LP objective throughout.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np, sys
sys.path.append('storage/noesis/pack')
import active_quench as AQ
from active_quench_kkt_guided import strict_finalize_kkt_guided

def construct_packing():
    C, r, S = strict_finalize_kkt_guided(
        total_sec=1080.0,
        seed=20251219,
        alpha0=1.1e-4,
        backtrack=0.5,
        alpha_min=1e-6,
        k_pairs_init=176,
        dK=12,
        segment_sec=30.0,
        w_dual=1.0,
        w_slack=1.0,
        boundary_push=0.68,
        pair_eps=5e-8,
        boundary_eps=5e-8
    )
    C, r, S = AQ.active_pair_quench(
        C, budget_sec=120.0, seed=20251219+1,
        k_pairs=248, alpha0=5.5e-5, backtrack=0.5, alpha_min=1e-6, boundary_push=0.70
    )
    assert C.shape == (26,2) and r.shape == (26,)
    assert np.all(r > 0)
    x, y = C[:,0], C[:,1]
    b = np.minimum.reduce([x, 1-x, y, 1-y])
    assert np.all(r <= b + 1e-9)
    return C, r
